```{r}
#DATA ANALYSIS FILE
#Load Library
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(sf)
#Importing dataset 
listings_Boston <- read.csv("C:/Users/Winson/Downloads/listings_Boston.csv", header = TRUE)
#Shows the first few elements
head(listings_Boston)
#Number of rows in dataset
nrow(listings_Boston)
listings_Boston[listings_Boston$price > 10000, ]
```

```{r}
#Filters out empty prices 
new_data <- listings_Boston[listings_Boston$price!= "", ]
head(new_data)
new_data[new_data$price > 10000, ]
new_data$city <- "Boston"

#Filters out symbols so that price can be a numeric
new_data$price <- gsub("[\\$, ]", "", new_data$price)
new_data$price <- as.numeric(new_data$price)
tax_rate <- 0.1525
new_data$price_with_tax <- new_data$price * (1 + tax_rate)
new_data
```

```{r}
#Makes the amenities a list to work with
new_data$amenities <- gsub("\\[|\\]|\"", "", new_data$amenities)
new_data$amenities <- strsplit(new_data$amenities, ", ")
head(new_data)
#Checks to see in amenities which if the amenities are missing
total_empty <- sum(sapply(new_data$amenities, length) == 0)
total_empty
#Filters out the ones if the amenities are missing
new_data <- new_data %>%
  filter(sapply(amenities, length) > 0)
new_data <- subset(new_data, price <= 1000)
new_data <- subset(new_data, minimum_nights < 120)
#Checks the outliers 
boston_outliers <- new_data[new_data$price >= 750 & new_data$price <= 1000, ]

#Calculates the price per guest for Boston 
new_data$price_per_guest <- new_data$price / new_data$accommodates
new_data$price_per_guest <- as.numeric(new_data$price_per_guest)

```

```{r}
new_data$amenities <- gsub("\\[|\\]|\"", "", new_data$amenities)
new_data$amenities <- strsplit(new_data$amenities, ", ")

clean_amenity <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  x <- gsub("\\\\u2013|–|—", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("\\\\u2019|u2019|u00e9", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("&", "and", x)
  x <- gsub("[[:punct:]]+", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  remove_exact <- c(
    "2 5 years old", "5 10 years old", "and 10 years old", "and 5 10 years old",
    "and dresser", "and wardrobe", "every day", "every day available",
    "7 days a week available", "open 24 hours", "open specific hours",
    "monday to friday available", "it varies", "small", "gas",
    "under the counter", "bosch", "integra", "martin logan", "toshiba",
    "disney", "coffee", "dove", "heated"
  )

  if (x %in% remove_exact) return(NA_character_)

  x <- gsub("\\balways at the listing\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bavailable upon request\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bdepending on availability\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bavailable all year\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bavailable seasonally\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bon property\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bnearby\\b", " nearby", x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  if (grepl("conditioner", x)) return("conditioner")
  if (grepl("body wash|shower gel", x)) return("body wash")
  if (grepl("soap", x)) return("body soap")
  if (grepl("toothpaste", x)) return(NA_character_)


  if (grepl("tv|television|roku|chromecast|premium cable|standard cable|amazon prime video|netflix|hulu|hbo max", x)) return("tv")
  if (grepl("dvd player", x)) return("dvd player")
  if (grepl("board games|arcade games|life size games", x)) return("games")
  if (grepl("game console|ps3|ps4|xbox|nintendo switch", x)) return("game console")
  if (grepl("piano", x)) return("piano")
  if (grepl("record player", x)) return("record player")
  if (grepl("sound system|speaker|alexa|google home|google assistant|bluetooth", x)) return("sound system")

  if (grepl("kitchen", x)) return("kitchen")
  if (grepl("microwave", x)) return("microwave")
  if (grepl("oven", x)) return("oven")
  if (grepl("stove|burners", x)) return("stove")
  if (grepl("refrigerator|fridge", x)) return("refrigerator")
  if (grepl("freezer", x)) return("freezer")
  if (grepl("dishwasher", x)) return("dishwasher")
  if (grepl("coffee maker|french press|pour over coffee|nespresso", x)) return("coffee maker")
  if (grepl("rice maker", x)) return("rice maker")
  if (grepl("bread maker", x)) return("bread maker")
  if (grepl("blender", x)) return("blender")
  if (grepl("toaster", x)) return("toaster")
  if (grepl("baking sheet", x)) return("baking sheet")
  if (grepl("barbecue utensils", x)) return("bbq utensils")
  if (grepl("cooking basics", x)) return("cooking basics")
  if (grepl("dishes and silverware", x)) return("dishes and silverware")
  if (grepl("wine glasses", x)) return("wine glasses")
  if (grepl("dining table", x)) return("dining table")
  if (grepl("breakfast", x)) return("breakfast")

  if (grepl("crib", x)) return("crib")
  if (grepl("high chair|booster seat", x)) return("high chair")
  if (grepl("baby bath", x)) return("baby bath")
  if (grepl("baby monitor", x)) return("baby monitor")
  if (grepl("changing table", x)) return("changing table")
  if (grepl("children s books and toys|books and reading material", x)) return("books and toys")
  if (grepl("children s bikes|bikes", x)) return("bikes")
  if (grepl("children s dinnerware", x)) return("children's dinnerware")
  if (grepl("baby safety gates|outlet covers|table corner guards|window guards", x)) return("child safety features")
  if (grepl("children s playroom|outdoor playground", x)) return("play area")
  if (grepl("babysitter recommendations", x)) return("babysitter recommendations")

  if (grepl("bathtub|bidet", x)) return("bathtub/bidet")
  if (grepl("hair dryer", x)) return("hair dryer")
  if (grepl("shampoo", x)) return("shampoo")
  if (grepl("conditioner", x)) return("conditioner")
  if (grepl("hot water", x)) return("hot water")
  if (grepl("bed linens", x)) return("bed linens")
  if (grepl("extra pillows and blankets", x)) return("extra pillows and blankets")
  if (grepl("hangers", x)) return("hangers")
  if (grepl("closet|wardrobe|clothing storage", x)) return("clothing storage")
  if (grepl("room darkening shades", x)) return("room darkening shades")
  if (grepl("mosquito net", x)) return("mosquito net")
  if (grepl("lock on bedroom door", x)) return("lock on bedroom door")
  if (grepl("private living room", x)) return("private living room")

  if (grepl("air conditioning|ceiling fan|portable fans", x)) return("air conditioning/fan")
  if (grepl("heating|portable heater", x)) return("heating")
  if (grepl("fireplace", x)) return("fireplace")

  if (grepl("washer", x)) return("washer")
  if (grepl("dryer", x)) return("dryer")
  if (grepl("laundromat nearby", x)) return("laundromat nearby")
  if (grepl("cleaning products", x)) return("cleaning products")
  if (grepl("cleaning available during stay|housekeeping", x)) return("housekeeping")

  if (grepl("wifi|ethernet", x)) return("internet")
  if (grepl("self check in|lockbox|smart lock", x)) return("self check-in")
  if (grepl("private entrance", x)) return("private entrance")
  if (grepl("elevator", x)) return("elevator")
  if (grepl("single level home", x)) return("single level home")
  if (grepl("building staff|host greets you", x)) return("host service")
  if (grepl("carbon monoxide alarm", x)) return("carbon monoxide alarm")
  if (grepl("smoke alarm", x)) return("smoke alarm")
  if (grepl("fire extinguisher", x)) return("fire extinguisher")
  if (grepl("first aid kit", x)) return("first aid kit")
  if (grepl("safe", x)) return("safe")
  if (grepl("exterior security cameras|noise decibel monitors", x)) return("security device")

  if (grepl("patio|balcony", x)) return("patio/balcony")
  if (grepl("outdoor dining area|outdoor furniture|sun loungers|hammock", x)) return("outdoor seating")
  if (grepl("bbq grill", x)) return("bbq grill")
  if (grepl("fire pit", x)) return("fire pit")
  if (grepl("hot tub", x)) return("hot tub")
  if (grepl("pool|lap pool", x)) return("pool")
  if (grepl("sauna", x)) return("sauna")
  if (grepl("gym|exercise equipment|free weights|stationary bike|rowing|treadmill|workout bench|yoga mat|elliptical", x)) return("gym/workout equipment")
  if (grepl("ping pong table|pool table", x)) return("game table")
  if (grepl("kayak", x)) return("kayak")
  if (grepl("boat slip", x)) return("boat slip")
  if (grepl("ev charger|tesla only|level 1|level 2", x)) return("ev charger")

  if (grepl("view|waterfront", x)) return("view")

  if (grepl("parking|garage", x)) return("parking")
  if (grepl("pets allowed", x)) return("pets allowed")
  if (grepl("long term stays allowed", x)) return("long term stays allowed")
  if (grepl("luggage dropoff allowed", x)) return("luggage dropoff allowed")
  if (grepl("essentials", x)) return("essentials")
  if (grepl("iron", x)) return("iron")
  if (grepl("bbq utensils", x)) return("bbq utensils")
  if (grepl("smoking allowed", x)) return("smoking allowed")

  remove_patterns <- c(
    "^c ", "^and ", "^there are ", "^varies", "^varied", "^variety",
    "^various", "^usually ", "^liquid ", "^generic ", "^organic ",
    "^eco ", "^premium ", "^private ", "^shared "
  )

  for (pat in remove_patterns) {
    if (grepl(pat, x)) return(NA_character_)
  }

  return(x)
}

new_data$amenities <- lapply(new_data$amenities, function(x) {
  x <- sapply(x, clean_amenity)
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  unique(x)
})

all_amenities <- sort(unique(unlist(new_data$amenities)))

cat("Total unique cleaned amenities:", length(all_amenities), "\n\n")

amenities_list <- data.frame(Amenity = all_amenities)

amenity_counts <- sort(table(unlist(new_data$amenities)), decreasing = TRUE)
print(amenity_counts)



final_cleanup <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(tolower(x))
  
  if (x %in% c(
    "100 vegan and cruelty free",
    "7 days a week available at extra cost",
    "every day available at extra cost",
    "monday to friday available at extra cost",
    "gilchrist and soames"
  )) return(NA_character_)
  
  if (x %in% c("ac split type ductless system", "window ac unit")) return("air conditioning/fan")
  if (x == "backyard fully fenced") return("backyard")
  if (x == "beach access beachfront") return("beach access")
  if (x == "body wash") return("body soap")
  if (x %in% c("espresso machine", "keurig coffee machine")) return("coffee maker")
  if (x == "free resort access") return("resort access")
  if (x == "free carport on premises 1 space") return("parking")
  if (x == "keypad") return("self check-in")
  
  return(x)
}

new_data$amenities <- lapply(new_data$amenities, function(x) {
  x <- sapply(x, final_cleanup)
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  unique(x)
})

all_amenities <- sort(unique(unlist(new_data$amenities)))

cat("Total unique cleaned amenities:", length(all_amenities), "\n\n")
print(all_amenities)
amenities_list <- data.frame(Amenity = all_amenities)
write.csv(amenities_list, "final_cleaned_amenities_v2.csv", row.names = FALSE)

amenity_counts <- sort(table(unlist(new_data$amenities)), decreasing = TRUE)
print(amenity_counts)
```

```{r}
  if (grepl("ev charger|tesla only|level 1|level 2", x)) return("ev charger")
  if (grepl("kayak", x)) return("kayak")
  if (grepl("boat slip", x)) return("boat slip")
  if (grepl("bowling alley", x)) return("bowling alley")
  if (grepl("climbing wall", x)) return("climbing wall")
  if (grepl("hockey rink", x)) return("hockey rink")
  if (grepl("mini golf", x)) return("mini golf")
  if (grepl("outdoor shower", x)) return("outdoor shower")
  if (grepl("skate ramp", x)) return("skate ramp")
  if (grepl("ski in ski out", x)) return("ski-in/ski-out")

  if (grepl("beach access", x)) return("beach access")
  if (grepl("lake access", x)) return("lake access")
  if (grepl("resort access", x)) return("resort access")
  if (grepl("view|waterfront", x)) return("view")

  if (grepl("parking|garage|carport|driveway|street parking", x)) return("parking")
  if (grepl("pets allowed", x)) return("pets allowed")
  if (grepl("long term stays allowed", x)) return("long term stays allowed")
  if (grepl("luggage dropoff allowed", x)) return("luggage dropoff allowed")
  if (grepl("essentials", x)) return("essentials")
  if (grepl("iron", x)) return("iron")
  if (grepl("dedicated workspace", x)) return("dedicated workspace")
  if (grepl("smoking allowed", x)) return("smoking allowed")
  if (grepl("beach essentials", x)) return("beach essentials")

  remove_patterns <- c(
    "^c ", "^and ", "^there are ", "^varies", "^varied", "^variety",
    "^various", "^usually ", "^liquid ", "^generic ", "^organic ",
    "^eco ", "^premium ", "^private ", "^shared ", "^available ",
    "^changes", "^different", "^regular", "^standard", "^luxury",
    "^hotel brand", "^bath amenity", "^one brand", "^for a few days"
  )

  for (pat in remove_patterns) {
    if (grepl(pat, x)) return(NA_character_)
  }

  x <- trimws(x)
  if (x == "") return(NA_character_)

  return(x)
}


Jersey_data$amenities <- lapply(Jersey_data$amenities, function(x) {
  x <- sapply(x, clean_amenity)
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  unique(x)
})

  "100 vegan and cruelty free",
  "1 day a week",
  "2 days a week",

  "tuesday",
  "wednesday"
)

Jersey_data$amenities <- lapply(Jersey_data$amenities, function(x) {

  unique(x)
```

```{r}
  ))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)  

amenities <- c("accommodates", "num_amenities", "tv", "dishes and silverware", 
               "gym/workout equipment", "parking", "cooking basics", "pets allowed", 
               "heating", "patio/balcony", "hot water", "air conditioning/fan")

cor_boston <- sapply(amenities, function(x) cor(new_data$price_per_guest, new_data[[x]], use="complete.obs"))
cor_jersey <- sapply(amenities, function(x) cor(Jersey_data$price_per_guest, Jersey_data[[x]], use="complete.obs"))

cor_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = amenities,
  Boston = cor_boston,
  JerseyCity = cor_jersey
)

cor_melt <- melt(cor_df, id.vars = "Variable", variable.name = "City", value.name = "Correlation")

ggplot(cor_melt, aes(x = City, y = Variable, fill = Correlation)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Correlation, 2)), color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Correlation of Amenities with Price per Guest", x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
model5_log <- lm(log(price_per_guest) ~ city + accommodates + num_amenities +

)

  "Model Combined"
)

for (i in 1:length(models)) {

  plot(
    models[[i]]$fitted.values, 
    residuals(models[[i]]), 
    main = paste("Residuals vs Fitted -", model_names[i]),
    xlab = "Fitted values",
    ylab = "Residuals",
    pch = 19, col = "steelblue"
  )
  abline(h=0, col="red", lwd=2)
  
  qqnorm(residuals(models[[i]]), main = paste("QQ Plot -", model_names[i]))

}
```

```{r}
    `air conditioning/fan` + `dishes and silverware` + `cooking basics` +

  family = binomial
)

summary(logit_under_100)

null_model <- glm(under_100 ~ 1, family = binomial, data = small_listings)
anova(null_model, logit_under_100, test = "Chisq")
```
